tools.name: find_exercise
tools.description: The exercise for a name in English; word order, plurals, abbreviations such as db, kb and rdl, and a small misspelling are understood. A match is the exercise of that name, or the one it means when the name leaves out the equipment or a word such as biceps. Returns id, name, category, equipment, bod

tools.name: list_exercises
tools.description: The exercises matching every filter given, at least one. Returns their count and, for each in the library's order, id, name and the still's URL. In a client with MCP Apps, such as Claude, every call shows the person its result as a card.

tools.name: show_workout
tools.description: Shows a training session, or a programme of several, as one card: each exercise with its drawing and what was prescribed, opening to its details when tapped. Exercises are named in English, in the call and on the card, and matched to the library's names, with word order, plurals, abbreviations and s
